review_note: Complete all three manus:B2.6-099 forms (12 main, one synthesis, three transfer items). Preserve core evidence source/strength, conditional cost estimates, staged expansion, review time, unapproved scope and claim-boundary-caveat relations when compressing. Editorial and perceptual review remain pending.
